senses.gloss: अर्य अर्य, m., f. या and यी, A man or woman of the third caste, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 17.

आर्य आर्य.
 I. m., f. या,
 1. Originally the name of the immigrated Indian people in opposition to the old inhabitants. In later times, the name of the three upper castes in opposition to the fourth, Yājñ. 2, 294; or to barbarians, [] MBh. 14, 2137.
 II. fem. या, The name of a metre. Rājat. 5, 35.
 III. adj., f. या.
 1. Respectable, venerable, Man. 8, 75; Daśak. in Chr. 186, 17.
 2. Apposite, Rām. 2, 115, 6.
 --Comp.

अर्यमन् अर्यमन्, m.
 1. The name of a deity, Rām. 2, 25, 8.
 2. The chief of the Pitṛs, or Manes, Bhag. 10, 29.

आर्यक आर्य + क, m.
 1. A grandfather, Rām. 5, 61, 15.
 2. A proper name, Mṛcch. 35, 22; MBh. 1, 1552.

आर्यता आर्य + ता, f. and आर्यत्व आर्य + त्व, n. Venerableness, Man. 7, 211; Rājat. 1, 110.
 --Comp.
आर्य- + आवर्त आर्य- + आवर्त, m. the holy land, extending from the eastern to the western sea, and bounded on the north and south by the Himālaya and Vindhya mountains, Man. 2, 22.
आर्य- + पुत्र आर्य- + पुत्र, m. the son of an Ārya, used to denote: 1. a prince, Rām. 6, 8, 38. 2. the son of an elder brother, 2, 23, 26. 3. a husband (by his wife), 3, 49, 9.
आर्य- + भाव आर्य- + भाव, m. honest behaviour, Rām. 1, 1, 35.
आर्य- + मिश्र आर्य- + मिश्र, m. pl. a respectable person, Rām. 2, 82, 18; Prab. 25, 2.
आर्य- + लिङ्गिन् आर्य- + लिङ्गिन्, adj. one who wears the signs of an Ārya, Man. 9, 260.

आर्य- + वृत्त आर्य- + वृत्त,
 I. n. the conduct of an Ārya, laudable practice, Man. 4, 175.
 II. adj. one who behaves in a laudable manner, Man. 9, 253.
आर्य- + वेश आर्य- + वेश, adj. dressed like an Ārya, or a respectable man, Rām. 1, 7, 6.
आर्य- + व्रत आर्य- + व्रत, adj. one who observes the rules of the Āryas, or respectable men, MBh. 1, 7424.
